title: Goldman Sachs Upgrades India to Overweight — Nifty Target 28,500 by 2027
description: FIIs sold ₹2 lakh crore. Goldman Sachs just said BUY India. GS upgrades India equities to Overweight with Nifty 50 target 28,500 — that's +13% upside from current levels. Find out why the world's biggest bank just turned bullish on Indian markets.
